data.title: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
data.description: arXiv:2611.08368v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. This enables principled cross-modality comparison on identical scenes and trajectories. We release the platform and a large indoor dataset with synchronized raw measurements and rich ground-truth annotations.
data.author: Sacha Jungerman, Kaustubh Sadekar, Avery Gump, Sriram Narayanan, Shantanu Gupta, Bhuyashi Deka, Srinivasa Narasimhan, Atul Ingle, Mohit Gupta
